findings.message: Sheet URL at `$['data']['hasPart'][2]['pagefront:sheetUrl']` is on host `sheets.elsewhere.example`; the canonical page is on `merchant.example`.
findings.remediation: Point `pagefront:sheetUrl` at the sheet on the host the edge requires: a member or parent sheet on the storefront host, a brand sheet on the host of the brand's `@id`. A consumer rejects a hint off that host and falls back to the entry's `url`.
